title: Règles officielles du marché
text:
This market refers to the doubles tennis match between Henry Patten / Neal Skupski and Kevin Krawietz / Tim Putz in the Davis Cup, originally scheduled for November 26 at 6:20AM ET.

This market will resolve to 'Henry Patten / Neal Skupski' if the team of Henry Patten / Neal Skupski advances against Kevin Krawietz / Tim Putz.

This market will resolve to 'Kevin Krawietz / Tim Putz' if the team of Kevin Krawietz / Tim Putz advances against Henry Patten / Neal Skupski.

If the match is canceled (not played at all), ends in a tie, or a winner has not been determined by December 10, 2026, 11:59 PM ET (14 days after the scheduled start), this market will resolve to 50-50.

If the match begins but is not completed, and one team advances due to the opponent's retirement, default, or disqualification, this market will resolve to the team who advances.

If the match ends in a walkover (a team withdraws before the start and the other advances automatically), this market will resolve to 50-50.

The primary resolution source will be official information from the International Tennis Federation. A consensus of credible reporting may also be used.
